author: CatBangsviaSkype
body:
How?

How on earth is Arcane_Horror unbanned? After reports, complaints and even staff watching Arcane_Horror in spectate mode, I finally prove, with solid proof and he gets unbanned? Sorry, but what? Not to mention the amount of bans he’s gotten? All for hacking?

So, the previous report I post about Arcane_Horror ends up with a overall mod decision and it goes the way of him receiving a ban for hacking, yet I get news that he has been unbanned? How? Myself and others are honestly puzzled about your decision as a team. First of all you think he's hacking, then you decide, 'Stuff this, let's unban him', sorry what? How on earth did Junr have a change of heart about solid evidence against Arcane who's had loads of reports against him, and before you say, 'How would you know how many reports he gets', surely that's the reason why mods tend to watch him a lot? No?

http://prnt.sc/ckpydy

Furthermore, his bans. http://prnt.sc/ckq1i8

All of these bans are practically for the same reason, I'm truly quite curious how he gets unbanned for all of those bans? First of all, does Avicus not have a ban limit? Meaning do you just let players who's been banned more than twice come back willy nilly? Perhaps it was false evidence, if it was, why were mods keep watching him? Odd, no? When I see people spectating Arcane, or I'm spectating him, I've always seen a mod watch him. Always. I'm just curious to why he gets unbanned so quick? Even so, many have said that it takes a while to get unbanned on Avicus, perhaps it's different for a 'False' ban? Of course, I can't say much, I also got banned almost 10 months ago for hacking, I accepted my ban because I knew what I did wrong, surely though, I would know about hacking? I played on Avicus without even being noticed with my hacked client, it took ages to ban me, wish I had a hacked client right now, I'd get unbanned straight away! Not to mention the hacked client I used 10 months ago, but my knowledge of hacks after a MCSG lecture about Hacker training, I know about hacked clients, whether it's Ghost, USB, or simple download bobs your uncle. However before anyone quotes 'Not enough evidence', please oh please explain what is wrong with the evidence I provided.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=O8cl4-B34MU&feature=youtu.be

Perhaps people think the reason he turned round was because of an enemy? Perhaps you're right? Although does look like a snap. Although if only I tabbed so you could see his ping, my ping and the server was fine, no lag whatsoever. Neither of us had ping lag. Whether you want to believe that is another story. 

This guy has been unbanned so many times, it's ridiculous, the amount of reports he gets, the amount of mods who watch him, the amount of complaints is hysterical. Honestly, if you really think he's legit. I'll get more proof, others will get more proof and he's banned by more proof which is given, unbanning him will do no justice, it'll just proof how unsure a staff team is, about making decisions about solid proof given to them. In addition, do Avicus staff not have the training to SS through TS? Or other software? I tell you now, next time one of you, a mod,  a Senior if not higher is watching Arcane, and feels so suspicious about his movements, not to mention how he just knows where every player is lmao. Think about SS ing him, it might show his hacked client.

Please reconsider.

Kind regards,

WantTheJaffa | Dominic Spicer

title: Arcane_Horror

replies.author: Junr
replies.body:
Hello, 
Only some staff members are fully trained to do screenshares, so screenshares aren't done without those trained Staff Members. During his appeal, I reviewed the evidence once more, and it turns out to actually be false. There's only one part where his head snaps, and that one part is when he attacked his team mate after killing an enemy. You can tell that he was reacting by swinging back because he thought his team mate was an enemy. You can see him pulling back his bow and if he truly had Kill Aura, he would of kept swinging with the bow, while it's pulled back, but he didn't. The sprint is a glitch, not a hack, I have seen regulars that have had the same scenario before, but it doesn't mean they hack, also, the leaf block covers you, so that doesn't make that sufficent enough either. When he is knocked off, he should of taken knock back in mid air, but hit the ground before it started and the fall damage stopped it, so it does not look like he took knockback at all. For the second anti-knockback part, he still takes knockback, but he takes it to the right and to add, there's also soul sand which also slows him down, reducing his knockback and making him seem like he has none at all. If you believe he is hacking after another false bans like the other-I know about the others- please create a video that is longer and more suffiecent then the original video. and when someone has a second chance, we won't unban them, since they did not use it wisely. 
Regards, 
Junr
